_comment: Pinned SHA-256 allowlist for marketplace plugins. This file is the TRUST ANCHOR: it ships in the wabot repo (not the plugin repo). installPlugin/update verify every downloaded file's hash against this before writing it to disk. If a hash is missing, installs fail closed — pin a known-good hash here before allowing a plugin. Regenerate with: node -e "const c=require('crypto'),fs=require('fs');console.log(c.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1])).digest('hex'))" plugins/<name>.js
